porcelain-cream.$description: Porcelain Cream — Primary canvas, light cards, light-button fill, and text on espresso surfaces

espresso-ink.$description: Espresso Ink — Primary text, dark page bands, dark filled buttons, input rules, and dark card surfaces

parchment-border.$description: Parchment Border — Hairline borders and restrained separators on light surfaces

stone-haze.$description: Stone Haze — Hero backdrop and muted architectural surface behind warm product imagery

ivory-sand.$description: Ivory Sand — Warm secondary surface, circular control fill, and contained graphic fields

daylight-wash.$description: Daylight Wash — Pale yellow feature-section background; it introduces the impression of natural daylight without becoming an interface accent

peach-wash.$description: Peach Wash — Muted warm section background for alternating editorial moments

sunlit-stone-gradient.$description: Sunlit Stone Gradient — Soft atmospheric background gradient for warm product and architectural scenes

systemia.$description: Primary interface and display family: 12-14px handles navigation, labels, forms, and buttons; 36px and 60px hold section headings; 170px and 240px create wall-scale editorial statements. The consistent medium 500 weight avoids heavy headline typography, letting scale rather than boldness carry the product’s presence.

azeret-mono.$description: Use only for oversized numerical statements beside Systemia punctuation or labels. Its -13.6px tracking makes numbers read as engineered measurements rather than conventional marketing statistics.
